hook: App Store chores, now from your terminal

beats.say: Rudrank Riyam released version 7.2 of App Store Connect CLI, his open-source command-line tool for managing apps on Apple's store.
It adds App Compliance for China, APNs key management from the terminal, schema checks in its API command, and validation that names the fix.
It also forgives guessed commands, and metadata pushes now patch only the fields that actually changed.
